description: Search open roles on the tracker. All filters optional and combined. `query` matches words in title, company and category; `days` limits to roles first seen in the last N days. Place: `city` (one of the 49 city pages, e.g. london, newyork, amsterdam, or any city name; matched the way the site's city pages match), `country` (ISO2 or name), `location` (free text substring). Catalogue: `list` (a ready-made list slug from browse_lists, e.g. proprietary-trading, quant-roles, united-kingdom), `kind` (a kind of firm: proprietary-trading-firms, hedge-funds, investment-banks, banks, advisory-boutiques, private-equity-firms, venture-capital-firms, asset-managers, private-banks-and-wealth-managers, exchanges-and-market-infrastructure, commodity-and-energy-firms, insurers-and-reinsurers, crypto-firms, brokers-and-trading-platforms, fintech-firms, strategy-consulting-firms, economic-consulting-firms, technology-firms, real-estate-investors). `workplace` remote / hybrid / on_site (firm-declared, present on a minority of roles). `language` (a name such as Greek, Dutch, Mandarin, or an ISO code) keeps roles whose ad asks for that language, required or as a plus; English is never tagged, since nearly every role asks for it. Roles carry `languages_required` / `languages_a_plus` where the ad names any. Unknown slugs match nothing and are named in `unknown`.

category.description: One of: Trading, Research, Investment Banking, Mergers & Acquisitions, Private Equity, Venture Capital, Asset Management, Strategy Consulting, Technology, Business & Operations, General

city.description: A city page slug or name (london, newyork, amsterdam, frankfurt, zurich, singapore, hongkong ...); see list_cities

company.description: Firm name or part of it, e.g. "Optiver"

country.description: ISO2 or country name: NL, GB, US, "Netherlands", "United Kingdom"

days.description: Only roles posted in the last N days

kind.description: Kind of firm slug: proprietary-trading-firms, hedge-funds, investment-banks, banks, advisory-boutiques, private-equity-firms, venture-capital-firms, asset-managers, private-banks-and-wealth-managers, exchanges-and-market-infrastructure, commodity-and-energy-firms, insurers-and-reinsurers, crypto-firms, brokers-and-trading-platforms, fintech-firms, strategy-consulting-firms, economic-consulting-firms, technology-firms, real-estate-investors

language.description: A language the ad asks for (required or a plus): a name such as "Greek", "Dutch", "Mandarin" or an ISO code such as el, nl, zh. Not English.

level.description: One of: Summer Internship, Off-Cycle Internship, Working Student, Graduate Program, Entry Level. Events and open days (the "Event / Open Day" level in career_alerts) are served by list_events, not here.

location.description: Free-text city or country substring, e.g. "Amsterdam", "Netherlands"

posted_after.description: ISO date; only roles posted on or after it

query.description: Words to match, e.g. "quant trading intern"

workplace.description: Where the work happens, as the firm declared it: remote, hybrid or on_site

name: search_jobs
title: Search roles
